Hi Emilio,

Thanks for the kind words about Harlo OS, and for being so decent about all of this.

I've noted that you're taking Georges' recommendation on the Overclocking bundle, and that's with him so he can arrange it once it lands.

On Shop····, your cancellation request is in, exactly as Georges left it open for you. I've put the order on hold on both our side and the warehouse side, so nothing ships or moves in the meantime. The cancellation itself, and the money going back to your original payment, are Georges' and Abel's to approve, so I won't put a figure or a date on it myself.

The team is offline today and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET. The answer comes straight back to you in this thread, so there's nothing further you need to send.

Sorry again for the way this one started, Emilio.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
